verdict.rationale: Wise Business is a payments and business-banking platform with no built-in AI agent or assistant, so plugging in MCP servers as a client to use their tools is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows Wise acting as an MCP client or hosting an agent. Its llms.txt and webhook OpenAPI spec are developer-facing resources, not MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
